Indigenous Health Assessment (Adults 15–54 years)

Medical History

- Current health concerns and risk factors:
  • Acute severe left-sided headache since 05:30 today; mild photophobia; minimal dizziness earlier  
  • History of recurrent but less severe headaches  
  • Work-related stress; recent late nights for “a couple of months”  
  • Past history of anxiety (2 years) on Sertraline  
- Relevant family medical history:
  • Mother – anxiety  
  • No family history of migraine or significant physical illnesses reported  
- Medications (including OTC or shared medications):
  • Sertraline – dose/route/frequency not documented  
  • Paracetamol taken today – dose not documented  
  • Planned: Ibuprofen (higher migraine dose) – details not yet prescribed  
- Immunisation status reviewed: Not recorded.  
- Sexual and reproductive health: Lives with partner; no further details recorded.  
- Physical activity and nutrition:
  • Runs ~3 times/week  
  • Diet described as “OK,” not overtly unhealthy; no further specifics  
- Alcohol, tobacco, and substance use:
  • Non-smoker  
  • Alcohol and other substances – not recorded  
- Hearing loss or concerns: Not recorded.  
- Mood/mental health (including depression, self-harm risk):
  • Ongoing anxiety; intermittent workplace anxiety but generally controlled  
  • Denies depressive symptoms or suicidal/self-harm thoughts  
- Vision problems or recent changes:
  • Photophobia associated with current headache; no baseline visual complaints  
- Family and social relationships, caring responsibilities:
  • Lives with partner; owns a cat  
  • Work currently highly stressful  

Examination

- BP, pulse rate and rhythm: Not recorded.  
- Height, weight, BMI, waist circumference (if indicated): Not recorded.  
- Oral exam (including dentition and gums): Not recorded.  
- Ear exam (otoscopy, whisper test if needed): Not recorded.  
- Vision/eye exam (basic screen): Not recorded.

Investigations (as indicated)

- Fasting BGL and lipids (or random BGL if needed): Not ordered.  
- Cervical screening (if eligible and due): Not addressed.  
- STI screen (urine or swab – chlamydia/gonorrhoea if age 15–35): Not addressed.  
- Mammogram (if eligible): Not addressed.  
- Other pathology (e.g., HbA1c, iron studies, Vitamin D): Considered if headaches persist; none ordered today.  

Management Plan

- Initiate Ibuprofen (first-line for migraine) and allow continued Paracetamol as needed.  
- Advise 1 week off work (self-certified) to reduce stress.  
- Provide self-referral link to local counseling service for stress/anxiety management.  
- Lifestyle advice: minimum 7–8 hours sleep nightly; hydrate 1.5–2 L non-caffeinated fluids daily.  
- Education: supplied written information on headache “red flag” symptoms and when to seek urgent review.  
- Follow-up telehealth appointment in 1 week to reassess symptoms; earlier review if headache worsens or new symptoms occur.  

Consider:
- Mental health support through counseling service (referral link provided).  
- Preventive health check (BP, BMI, immunizations, alcohol/smoking review) at next visit.  
- CTG registration and EPC allied health referral if chronic disease identified in future.

Quality checks
● Missing but clinically expected elements: Objective vital signs (BP, HR), physical exam, BMI, waist circumference, immunization review, alcohol intake details, cervical/STI screening status, urinalysis.  
● Internal contradictions: None noted.  
● Transcript quality: Clear audio; no significant omissions, but objective clinical data not obtainable in remote consult.
